summary: The test suite only validates GitHub Actions workflow YAML structure (triggers, jobs, permissions, actionlint) and does not test the core semantic versioning bumper functionality. Missing: unit tests for version parsing, conventional commit analysis, version bumping logic (feat→minor, fix→patch, breaking→major), changelog generation, version file updates, error handling, and fixture-based integration tests. The task explicitly requires red/green TDD with comprehensive testing including act-based end-to-end validation, but this test covers none of the actual bumper script logic. While the workflow structure test is well-organized with clear assertions, it would not catch any regressions in the core functionality.
